summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container in the rdflib SPARQL plugin. Changes: Update class in sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in sparql/algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue from the single declaration group before its early exit); evalUpdate in sparql/update.py iterates update.algebra; prepareUpdate added in sparql/processor.py and exported from sparql/__init__.py; processUpdate and the string path are unchanged. Added test/test_sparql_prepare.py covering prepare/apply, reuse, initNs, initial bindings, direct evaluation, container shape, empty and declarations-only requests, empty strings, and no-mutation. Nothing was run, per instructions, so tests are unverified; the prepareQuery and DAWG tests have not been executed. Not committed. Possible note: test_dawg.py's debug pprintAlgebra call now receives an Update object; it is inside a try block and I left the test unchanged.
